posts.text:
The Postmaster General is complaining I was too harsh when I asked him why Missourians’ mail isn’t being delivered 

Newsflash: in Missouri, we expect the government to DO ITS JOB. 

No bonuses; just mail delivered ON TIME


Josh Hawley (@HawleyMO)

Why is the Postmaster General of the United States receiving massive bonuses while Americans aren't getting their mail?

If this doesn't change, he needs to resign

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/HawleyMO/status/2069842007325901170#m
